hooks.command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])git([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' && printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq '(^|[^[:alnum:]_-])(commit|push)([^[:alnum:]_-]|$)' || printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])gh[[:space:]]+pr[[:space:]]+(create|merge)'; then echo 'Blocked by project rule: Claude may not commit or push in map-layers. The owner does this.' >&2; exit 2; fi
